E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has the entry Nyelâyu [yly] merging both Balade-Arama-Tiari and Belep, but they are not intelligible to monolinguals
(**hh:g:McCracken:Belep**:30) and should thus be separate entries
(like they are in previous surveys, such as
**hh:hvwtyp:Leenhardt:Austro-Melanesie**). It is missing from E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29. See also: Belep [yly].
